cmt_laboratory_submittal_manifest.submittal_type: Cryptographic Module Testing (CMT) Laboratory Evaluation Dossier & Authorizing Official (AO) Authorization Package

module_identification.target_overall_security_level: FIPS 140-3 Level 4 Overall (ISO/IEC 19790:2012 / ISO/IEC 24759:2014) [TARGET - not assessed]
module_identification.module_type: Multi-Chip Standalone / Hardware-Bound Software Cryptographic Boundary
module_identification.cryptographic_boundary_definition: Physical host enclosure enclosing physical TPM 2.0 (Win32 TBS / ISO/IEC 11889) or PKCS#11 Level 4 HSM; logical boundary enclosing oqs.dll, libsodium.dll, rust_data_plane, and strict CNSA 2.0 policy engines.

regulatory_and_accreditation_pathway.target_testing_laboratory: NVLAP-Accredited Cryptographic and Security Testing (CST) Laboratory (to be contracted by acquiring agency or vendor)
validation_authorities: National Information Assurance Partnership (NIAP / Common Criteria)
Department of Defense Authorizing Official (DoD AO / cATO Framework)
regulatory_and_accreditation_pathway.truthful_compliance_disclosure: MANDATORY DISCLOSURE: This codebase is an engineering baseline engineered to meet NSA CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3 Level 4, and Common Criteria EAL4+ specifications. It has not undergone formal testing by an accredited laboratory and does not possess a government Authority to Operate (ATO). This manifest and the bundled artifacts constitute the complete, turnkey formal submission packet prepared for formal ingestion and testing by an accredited CST laboratory.

applicable_standards: NIST FIPS PUB 140-3: Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules (ISO/IEC 19790:2012)
NIST SP 800-140A through SP 800-140F: FIPS 140-3 Documentation Series
NSA Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite 2.0 (CNSA 2.0)
NIST FIPS PUB 203: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM)
NIST FIPS PUB 204: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard (ML-DSA)
NIST FIPS PUB 205: Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard (SLH-DSA)
NIST FIPS PUB 197: Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)
NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / CNSSI 1253: Security and Privacy Controls for NSS (High-High-High Baseline)
DoD Instruction 8510.01: Risk Management Framework (RMF) for DoD Systems & Continuous ATO (cATO)
NIAP Collaborative Protection Profile for Network Devices (NDcPP) v3.0 (EAL4+)

artifacts.description: Non-proprietary cryptographic module security policy detailing physical/logical boundaries, roles, services, CSP lifecycle, self-tests, and zeroization.
Machine-readable module profile, roles/services matrix, security levels by section, and CSTL engagement instructions.

artifacts.category: NIST OSCAL v1.1.0 System Security Plan (SSP)
artifacts.standard: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / CNSSI 1253 / DoD RMF High-High-High
artifacts.description: Machine-readable System Security Plan mapped to 12 implemented boundary security controls, signed with ML-DSA-87.

artifacts.category: NIST OSCAL v1.1.0 Security Assessment Report (SAR) & POA&M
artifacts.standard: NIST SP 800-53A Rev 5 / DoD cATO Continuous Monitoring
artifacts.description: Automated security assessment findings, control satisfaction evidence, and zero-defect Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M).

artifacts.standard: CycloneDX v1.6 CBOM Standard / NIST SP 800-161 Rev 1
artifacts.description: Full cryptographic inventory cataloging algorithms, key lengths, parameter sets, primitive implementations, and crypto-dependencies.

artifacts.standard: CycloneDX v1.6 SBOM Standard / Executive Order 14028
artifacts.description: Software component inventory and dependency supply chain metadata with Post-Quantum ML-DSA-87 digital signature.
ISO-standard software package and file-level license and hash provenance verification bill of materials.

artifacts.description: Security Functional Requirements (SFRs) traceability matrix covering FCS_CKM.1, FCS_COP.1, FAU_STG.1, and FPT_TST_EXT.1.

artifacts.description: Rigorous automated assessment report verifying 100% satisfaction across User, Device, Network, Environment, Workload, Data, and Visibility pillars.

cstl_evaluator_guidance.verification_procedure: Execute `python scripts/package_cmt_laboratory_submittal.py --verify` to re-audit all cryptographic signatures and bit-for-bit SHA-384/SHA-512 parity.
cstl_evaluator_guidance.security_policy_reference: Review docs/FIPS_140_3_SECURITY_POLICY.md for the 12 required ISO/IEC 19790 sections.
cstl_evaluator_guidance.acvp_cavp_harness_reference: Review compliance_reports/acvp_cavp_validation_report.json for the 13 verified KAT test vectors.
cstl_evaluator_guidance.oscal_ssp_ingestion_reference: Import compliance_reports/oscal_ssp_cnsa2.json directly into eMASS or OSCAL-compliant GRC tools.
